title: Integration technical runway and risk register — Veridian Health weekly sync
agenda: Runway to MVP: remaining milestones and owners
Risk register review and mitigation updates
Open questions for Veridian security and networking
summary: Weekly sync focused on final technical runway items for Veridian Health integration. Progress on Dedicated cluster bootstrapping and key gating items (mTLS cert provisioning, customer VPC peering, initial model pinning). Several medium risks were re-prioritized; immediate focus is on automated KV cache warmup and a fallback model variant for latency spikes.
decisions: Ship canary config with model-quant-v1 as primary; model-fallback-quant-v0 will be available via routing policy for degraded infra (Decided by Solutions + Infra)
Approve 48-hour accelerated cert rotation window for Veridian test cluster (SRE + Security)
Move daily sync to M/W/F for next two weeks while Veridian runs validation suites
action_items: Ethan: Finish helm values override for dedicated pools (target 2026-10-12) — PROSERV-342
Sofia: Implement automated KV-cache seeding job; add smoke test (target 2026-10-11) — INTEG-178
Miguel: Validate model-fallback routing in staging and produce latency numbers (target 2026-10-09)
Asha: Draft customer-facing runbook section for failover behavior and share with Veridian (target 2026-10-10)
Priya: Coordinate SOC questionnaire responses; confirm remaining gaps with Veridian security (target 2026-10-13)
open_risks: Cert provisioning race: customer's CA pipeline occasionally delays cert issuance by 6–12 hours — impacts bootstrap and early validation
KV cache cold-start: initial traffic pattern shows 2–3s token-latency penalty on first burst if seeding not completed
Quantized model fidelity: small hallucination regression observed in internal evals when switching to quant-v1 for specific prompt families
VPC egress rules: Veridian has stricter egress controls; some telemetry endpoints blocked until additional allowlist is signed
Scaling under sustained burst: Dedicated pool autoscaler needs tuning for unpredictable nightly workload spikes
notes:
Notes / running log:

- Infra bootstrap: Ethan reported cluster creation succeeded for veridian-test-1; however two nodes failed GPU driver post-provision and required manual reprovisioning. Root cause likely a newer AMI + driver mismatch. ACTION: Ethan to pin AMI in helm chart and add driver-smoke check to node bootstrap sequence. (See git PR: github.com/redwood-inference/veridian-helm-chart/pull/9)

- Certs: Veridian's security team requested shorter rotation TTL for test certs. Security and SRE agreed to 48-hour window for test cluster; production will follow standard 90-day TTL. Need signed docs from Veridian (Priya to chase).

- Networking: Laura (Veridian) confirmed that egress to metrics.redwood.ai is blocked by default. We proposed two options: 1) allowlist 3 metrics endpoints for the test window, or 2) run a sidecar proxy inside Veridian cluster to relay telemetry. Veridian prefers option 1 for speed; network ticket created (NET-602).

- Runtime/model: Miguel ran the primary prompt suite (2000 samples) with model-quant-v1 -> overall latency median 78ms per token but 0.8% of prompts hit >1.2s due to cold KV cache. With seeding job enabled in staging, long-tail reduced to 0.05%. Quant-v1 had a small precision drop on date-parsing prompts; Research to triage.

- Observability: We will add a per-route flag in Console to show whether request used fallback variant; this helps Veridian debug. Sofia to add telemetry tag "veridian.fallback_used".

- Deploy rollouts: Decided to run a canary (2% traffic) for 48 hours, then 20% for 24 hours, then full. Canary policy will include automatic rollback on token-error-rate >0.5% or latency p95 > +30% baseline. Asha to own canary runbook and coordinates.

- Customer validation plan: Veridian to run functional test harness (5 suites) by 2026-10-15. If green, schedule production cutover window 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-22.

- Unresolved questions:
  * Who approves emergency changes during their business hours? (Assigned to Veridian PM; follow-up needed)
  * Acceptable fidelity delta threshold for quantized model? Research to propose measurable metric by 2026-10-09.

- Misc: added short-term workaround: enable request-level caching for verification endpoints to reduce hit rate on cold model. This is a temporary mitigation until KV seeding is in place.

Next sync: 2026-10-09 10:00 PDT (standing M/W/F) — agenda will focus on cert status, KV-seeding progress, and canary metrics.
